Kill [[Arbor Earthcall]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Kill Arbor Earthcall in the [[Morostav Trail]].
* *BONUS* Kill Arbor Earthcall in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 500 [[Kurzick faction|Kurzick Faction]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
Leave from [[Durheim Archives]], [[Vasburg Armory]] or [[Unwaking Waters (Kurzick)]]. Even though he appears to be alone, six [[Warden of Seasons|Wardens of Seasons]] will [[popup]] when you get close to his initial location. However, as he has a larger-than-usual [[aggro bubble]], you can [[pull]] him towards you without [[spawn|spawning]] those Wardens of Seasons.
